setup: Android 12 emulator (API 31), signed minified Release APKs, ART speed compilation. Scroll a four-column grid of 5,000 cells for eight seconds at 800 pixels per second after 1.8 seconds of startup. Run before/after/after/before. The recent gfxinfo interval contains up to 120 frames.

assets.preparation: Scale examples/component-parity/assets/images/parity_sample.png to 64 by 64 pixels with sips -z 64 64. Use the same image for the referenced and unused drawables.

instrumentation:
from pathlib import Path
import shutil,sys
probe,source=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3])
target=probe/sys.argv[3]/'android'
shutil.copytree(source,target,dirs_exist_ok=True)
package=target/'app/src/main/java/dev/nexa/drawableids'
path=package/'NexaGenerated.kt'
code=path.read_text()
needle='                    val nexaGridState0 = rememberLazyGridState()\n'
assert needle in code
code=code.replace(needle,needle+'''                    androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(nexaGridState0) {
                        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(1800)
                        val firstLookups = NexaDrawableBench.lookups
                        val firstLookupNanos = NexaDrawableBench.lookupNanos
                        val firstCpu = android.os.Process.getElapsedCpuTime()
                        val start = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                        var last = start
                        var callbacks = 0
                        nexaGridState0.scroll {
                            while (last - start < 8_000_000_000L) {
                                androidx.compose.runtime.withFrameNanos { }
                                val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                                scrollBy(((now - last) * 0.0000008).toFloat())
                                last = now
                                callbacks++
                            }
                        }
                        android.util.Log.i("NexaListBench", org.json.JSONObject()
                            .put("nameLookups", NexaDrawableBench.lookups - firstLookups)
                            .put("lookupMillis", (NexaDrawableBench.lookupNanos - firstLookupNanos) / 1e6)
                            .put("startupLookups", firstLookups)
                            .put("cpuMillis", android.os.Process.getElapsedCpuTime() - firstCpu)
                            .put("wallSeconds", (last - start) / 1e9)
                            .put("nativeFrameCallbacks", callbacks)
                            .put("lastItem", nexaGridState0.firstVisibleItemIndex)
                            .put("pssKiB", android.os.Debug.getPss()).toString())
                    }
''')
path.write_text(code+'''
internal object NexaDrawableBench {
    var lookups = 0
    var lookupNanos = 0L
}
''')
for path in package.glob('NexaGenerated*.kt'):
    code=path.read_text()
    needle='''        context.resources.getIdentifier(
            name,
            "drawable",
            context.packageName,
        )'''
    if needle in code:
        code=code.replace(needle,'''        val started = System.nanoTime()
        val resolved = context.resources.getIdentifier(name, "drawable", context.packageName)
        NexaDrawableBench.lookupNanos += System.nanoTime() - started
        NexaDrawableBench.lookups++
        resolved''',1)
        path.write_text(code)
